subject: Thinking about Tennr's next move in New York
body:
Hi Madison,

Noticed Tennr has 18 open roles right now — the kind of hiring pace that usually puts space on the table within a quarter or two.

At that pace, the calculus on current space tends to shift faster than the lease renewal cycle suggests. Worth a short conversation, even if only to put a marker down?

Michael Hartley
Hartley CRE Partners
